close_reason: Replaced misleading subParts comment with accurate description
description: email.rs lines 1160-1173: apply_body_properties_recursive recurses into subParts, then calls apply_body_properties(*node) which rebuilds the node from scratch keeping only keys in props. The comment 'Restore subParts if it survived filtering (it won't be in the default list). Nothing extra to do — apply_body_properties already kept it if props contains subParts' is misleading because: (1) the subParts key survives only if the caller explicitly listed 'subParts' in bodyProperties, (2) the recursion into children happens BEFORE the parent is filtered, meaning children are filtered with their own props before the parent loses the subParts key. The code is correct, but the comment implies the post-filter state may already have subParts present when in practice the default path strips it. The comment should describe what actually happens: 'subParts is included in the filtered output only when bodyProperties explicitly lists it; the default list does not include it so bodyStructure trees are returned as leaf nodes unless the client asks for subParts.'
title: apply_body_properties_recursive: misleading comment about subParts preservation
